newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, tin, nickel prices recover.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, tin, nickel prices recover.

text.p: Copper, tin and nickel prices recovered some recent losses on Wednesday, dealers said.
Base metals were steady in a narrow band. Copper, nickel and tin attracted fresh physical buying at the lower level. Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,650 rupees per quintal.

Tin rose by 100 rupees to 35,600 and nickel rose by 200 rupees to 37,600 per quintal. On Tuesday copper was down by 50 rupees, tin was down by 100 rupees and nickel was down by 300 rupees per quintal.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,250 rupees per quintal. So was zinc at 6,200 rupees and lead at 4,925 rupees per quintal.
